title.narrative: Guatemala: Facilitating Exports and Investment through enhanced digitalisation of government services and promotion of sustainable and inclusive trade with the EU

description.narrative:
This project aims to strengthen trade and investment flows between the European Union and Guatemala, building on the Association Agreement between the EU and Central America and contributing to the Global Gateway Investment Agenda (GGIA) for Guatemala. It pursues two core objectives:
- Facilitating trade and investment by advancing the digitalization of trade and investment-related procedures and supporting the effective implementation of the national competition policy; and - Enhancing the competitiveness of the pharmaceutical and clothing industries through increased sustainability, digitalization, and inclusiveness.
The main beneficiaries of the project include: For Objective 1: the Ministry of Economy, the National Trade Facilitation Committee and the Competition Authority For Objective 2: the private sector organizations and their member companies operating in the pharmaceutical and textiles and clothing sectors and European investors interested in setting operations in Guatemala
